ops.title: uv_build packs gitignored package-data files; homebrew-tap's reusable release-pypi-build has a pre-build input for artifact-baking steps
ops.body:
Two verified facts (2026-07-19, spawnllm oracle-inversion work):

1. **uv_build includes gitignored non-Python files** inside the module dir in BOTH wheel and sdist with zero config — verified by gitignoring `spawnllm/_core/spawnllm_core.wasm` and finding it in `unzip -l dist/*.whl` and `tar tzf dist/*.tar.gz`. A wheel with only data-file additions stays `py3-none-any`.

2. **`yasyf/homebrew-tap/.github/workflows/release-pypi-build.yml@pypi-v1` has a `pre-build` input** — repo-specific shell run after `uv version --frozen` stamping and before `uv build`, from the repo root (cc-sentiment already uses it). For baking build artifacts into a wheel (e.g. a wasm blob), pass `pre-build: rustup target add wasm32-wasip1 && bash scripts/build_wasm.sh` instead of inlining the whole build job — ubuntu runners ship rustup+stable. Callers must use `secrets: inherit`. maturin mode forbids pre-build.

See [[spawnllm-v040-ecosystem]] for the consumer landscape.
